notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.1.0
notes.content:
Dear Town Builders,

Over the past two weeks, besides routine bug fixes, we've focused mainly on:

Reworking the furniture categories: now you can browse by space or function, with brand-new secondary filters, favorites, and improved icons for recoloring and four-way rotation, plus more filtering options.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106207/c8cc70e3dc3537b8ab341635caa8ce4e4d734e84.png"]

Adding three new houses (small, medium, large) that can be discovered in town – all of them support floorplan changes.


Introducing 100+ new pieces of furniture, with more complete sets available.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106207/41b1b3844cad41815fec7e51df795930117c9c58.png"]

Creating an independent Building Materials category, including new windows, partitions, and railings.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106207/d6d71ba06460af58a5159a2b98963757de83c60d.png"]

Adding RGB color customization for more freedom, and allowing wall/floor editing in the starter home's kitchen and bathroom.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106207/4d6396b9b0a6414b8012e7e13be67acd00438a51.png"]

Updating our trailer, now featuring community-selected decoration highlights – thank you for sharing your creations!


[hr][/hr]

v1.0.1.0 Patch Notes
Fixes

Fixed an issue where some rotated objects in the Graveyard prevented quest completion.

Fixed a soft-lock during bartending.

Fixed abnormal duplicate occurrences.

Fixed UI and icon display errors.

Fixed furniture disappearing or being unplaceable in the Storage.

Fixed Storage refresh not updating after recycling.

Fixed Ideal Home Showroom items incorrectly allowed in the Storage .

Fixed color customization errors on certain furniture.

Fixed outlines showing when hovering during photo mode.

Fixed various visual errors (layers, volumes, exposure).

Fixed animation issues with the Science Gift Box.

Fixed mattress errors after room switching.

Fixed hospital drawer blocked by incorrect collision.

Fixed input being disabled after accidentally triggering a text field.

Fixed leftover occlusion after rotating containers (tables, etc.) around other items.

Fixed ovens locking incorrectly after cooling when switching rooms.

Fixed Steam Deck videos not playing.

Fixed counter errors when recycling dishes.

Fixed bathtub interaction errors after cloud save conflicts.

Fixed Ideal Home Showroom/presets not storing feature data.

Fixed Ideal Home Showroom/presets not saving animation states.

Fixed extra counting of objects in Company test quests.

Fixed missing localization in some places.

Adjusted art for several objects.

Adjusted certain UI displays.

Made Subspace objects non-removable.

Adjusted some junk pile locations.

Adjusted outer outline flicker effects.

New & Improved Features

Added bus stop names to the Town.

Added recolor and four-way rotation icons for Storage.

Added automatic quest tracking trigger when the robot disappears in the instrument shop.

Added quest tracking tips showing both source object and placement target.

Added sticker transparency settings.

Added one-click option in the Storage.

Added multiple objects supporting four-way rotation and more states.

Added more achievement completion methods.

Added automatic virtual keyboard on Steam Deck.

Added keybinding reset function.

All player homes and random Ideal Home Showroom:

Windows updated visually.

Windows are now movable, purchasable, sellable, and storable in Storage.

Updated recolor panel: new Advanced Mode – Free Color plus improved dual-color visuals.

Starter home kitchen and bathroom: added new recolor skins (two variants).

Added 3 new houses and quests, plus house-purchasing feature.

Updated warehouse categories: new space-based and function-based filters, with secondary filter support.

Added purchasable clothes racks at the clothing store.

Optimized preset cover image display.


[hr][/hr]


✨ Thank you again for all your feedback and for sharing your wonderful creations – your support keeps making the town more lively and cozy!

—GD Studio

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.0.6
notes.content:
v1.0.0.6 Patch Notes

Replaced problematic and questionable assets

Added fine-tuning sensitivity option; holding LT on controller switches sensitivity.

Fixed an issue where custom interaction keys were not working.

Added keyboard controls for camera zoom in/out.

Added custom key bindings: Zoom In, Zoom Out.

Removed time display from the weather UI; weather panel now auto-hides.

Fixed an issue in Ideal Home where saves loaded too late, causing features to miss loading (stacking left only one book).

Fixed right joystick scrolling in the storage being too slow.

Fixed localization error when putting potted plants into the storage.

Fixed errors when placing containers in Subspace or Luna’s secret room.

Added long-press hint for the bakery mirror.

Fixed priority logic error in the upper-left display of sand piles.

Added setting to display timeline.

Fixed an extra record appearing in the collection.

Fixed preset blank slot count increasing too quickly.

Fixed some localization issues.

Fixed incorrect inventory deduction when loading presets requiring combined items (e.g., mattress composition reading error).

Presets will no longer clear items when there are insufficient items in the warehouse.

Fixed an issue where, after cleaning garbage, running it off screen before the UI animation finished would cause it to remain uncleared.

Fixed preset images displaying incorrectly; local images now delete properly when presets are removed.

Adjusted volume (size) of the kitchen knife.

Fixed issue where Jane’s deletion timing was not correct, causing two Janes to appear.


We sincerely apologize to the Moonfrost team, their artists, and those who have been following Whisper of the House for the misused assets. We will continue to conduct a thorough review of all our assets to ensure that no questionable materials remain.

notes.title: Apology and Replacement of Inappropriate Content with a New Room
notes.content:
Dear all,

We sincerely apologize for the inappropriate content and the absence of necessary content warnings. Upon reflection, we realize we failed to anticipate how distressing some elements could be, which was a significant oversight on our part.

The inappropriate content has already been removed and replaced with a new room in this update. 

It was never our intention to cause harm, and we deeply regret any distress this may have caused. We appreciate your valuable feedback and will continue to do our best to improve.

Thank you for your understanding.

Sincerely,
GD Studio

notes.title: "Whisper of the House" Playtest Open!
notes.content:
"Whisper of the House" Playtest Open! 

Dear Players,
Thank you for your interest and support for "Whisper of the House"! 
After about a year and a half of dedicated development, we’re thrilled to finally share that the Whisper of the House Playtest is now officially open! If it’s your first time stepping into Whisper Town, welcome! And if you’ve played our demo before, there’s fresh content for you this time around. Here’s some info about this test version:

- You will move into Whisper Town and take on tasks from two neighbors, experiencing moving work in three houses, each with multiple rooms.
- Explore the town, enjoy the day-night cycle and weather changes, and use the new features of collecting items and drawing furniture to create your own home.
- You can now save your progress at any time in the game and return to past moments, which we believe will help you better complete tasks without regrets.

Playtest Details:
- "Require Access" Closing Time: Nov 24th, 24:00 PT
- Test supported languages: Chinese, English, Janpenese
- BUG Report & Suggestion: As this is still a development version, you might encounter some issues like glitches or inaccurate localization during gameplay. We really appreciate your patience and understanding. If you’d like to report bugs or share your feedback, please use this survey: https://forms.gle/uXHWUZ46hXnaWohQ9

We’d also love to have you join our Discord to chat with fellow players and discuss the game: https://discord.gg/NXMG4wrdHU

GD Studio & Lightning Games
